CITY OF LA VERNE
  PLANNING  COMMISSION
  MINUTES OF THE REGULAR  MEETING
  Wednesday, March 13, 2024
  At The Community Center

1  Vice Chairperson  Allison called the meeting of the La Verne Planning
  Commission  to order at 6:30 p. m.

2.  PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  Commissioner  Duffy led the Ptedge of Allegiance

3  ROLL GALL: Planning Commissioners present: Thomas Allison, Jeremy
  Conrad, Keny Chang, and Erin Duffy. Advisory personnel present:
  Community  Development  Director Eric Scherer, City Attorney Kimberly Hall
  Barlow, Principal Planner Candice Bowcock, Assistant Planner Parker
  Stringfellow, Assistant  Planner Gabriel Rivera, and Planning lntern Valerie
  Chin. Absent: Chairperson Jason Simison.

4.  MINUTES -  January 10,2024

  It was moved by Commissioner Chang and seconded by Commissioner
  Dufu to approve the minutes of the January 10, 2024 meeting. Motion
  carried by a 4-0 vote.

5.  PUBLIC COMMENT

  None

PUBLIC HEARINGS

1  CASE NO. O5. 24VAR -  2095 ELEVENTH STREET . VARIANCE TO
  ALLOW FOR THE CONVERSION  OF A SUNROOM PATIO TO LIVING
  SPACE FOR A SINGLE. FAMILY  RESIDENCE  WITH A SUBSTANDARD
  GARAGE

  RESOLUTION  NO. 1323

  A RESOLUTION  OF THE PLANNING  COMMISSION  OF THE CITY OF
  LA VERNE, CALIFORNIA GRANTING  A VARIANCE TO ALLOW FOR
  THE CONVERSION  OF A SUNROOM PATIO TO LIVING SPACE FOR A
  SINGLE.FAMILY RESIDENCE  WITH A SUBSTANDARD GARAGE ON

  THE PROPERTY LOCATED AT 2095 ELEVENTH  STREET ( CASE NO.
  05-24VAR).

  Assistant Planner Parker Stringfellow presented his staff report. The
  applicanUhomeowner,  Daniel Leonard, was present at the meeting.

  Vice Chairperson Allison opened public comment. There were no
  comments.  Chairperson  Allison closed public comment.

  The commissioners  stated that the report was thorough and they had no
  questions.

  It was moved by Commissioner  Conrad and seconded  by Commissioner
  Duffy to approve Resolution No. 1323. Motion carried by a 4-0 vote.

2.  CASE NO. 1O.24CUP .  1568 FOOTHILL BOULEVARD, UNIT 170 -
  CONDITIONAL  USE PERMIT FOR CLUB PILATES

  RESOLUTION  NO. 1322

  A RESOLUTION  OF THE PLANNING  COMMISSION  OF THE CITY OF
  LA VERNE, CALIFORNIA, APPROVING CASE NO. 1O. 24CUP  TO
  ALLOW THE OPERATION  OF A PILATES STUDIO AT { 568 FOOTHILL
  BOULEVARD,  UNIT # 170 AND AFFIRMING  A CATEGORICAL
  EXEMPTION FROM THE CALIFORNIA ENVIRONMENTAL  QUALIW
  ACT.

  Assistant  Planner Gabriel Rivera presented his staff report. The applicant,
  Shahin Tehranchi, was present at the meeting.

  Vice Chairperson Allison opened public comment. There were no
  comments. Vice Chairperson  Allison closed public comment.

  It was moved by Vice Chairperson  Allison and seconded by Commissioner
  Conrad to approve Case No. 10-24CUP. Motion carried by a 4-0 vote.

3.  I912 ARROW HIGHWAY- CONDITIONAL
  CASE NO. 14O. 23CUP -  USE
  PERMIT TO ALLOW FOR  TYPE 20 BEER AND WINE LICENSE  FOR
  LARIOS MEAT MARKET.

  RESOLUTION  NO. 1321

  A RESOLUTION  OF THE PLANNING  COMMISSION  OF THE CITY OF
  LA VERNE, CALIFORNIA, APPROVING CASE NO. O7. 24CUP, A
  CONDITIONAL  USE PERMIT TO ALLOW FOR A TYPE 20 BEER AND
  WINE LICENSE FOR THE BUSINESS, LARIOS MEAT MARKET,

  2

  LOCATED AT  1912  ARROW  HIGHWAY.
  COMMERCIAUMANUFACTURING,  AND AFFIRMING  THAT  THE
  PROJECT IS CATEGORICALLY EXEMPT FROM THE CALIFORNIA
  ENVIRONMENTAL  QUALITY  ACT AND FINDING THAT THE PROJECT
  SERVES THE PUBLIC CONVENIENCE  OR NECESSITY.

  Principal Planner Candice Bowcock presented the staff report. The
  applicant, Brett Engstrom, was present at the meeting.

  Vice Chairperson Allison opened public comment. The applicant stated that
  he represents the property owner/ business owner and it is a family run
  business. He said they wanted to attend the meeting, but something came
  up at the last minute. He said they are very excited to open a new location
  in La Verne and they have 2 other locations in Covina and Chino Hills. Vice
  Chairperson  Allison closed public comment.

  It was moved by Commissioner  Conrad and seconded  by Commissioner
  Chang to approve Case No. 07- 24CUP. Motion carried by a 4-0 vote.

COMMISSIONER  COMMENTS

  Commissioner Chang shared that he attended a three- day Planning
  Commissioners  Academy last week in Long Beach. He stated he learned a
  lot and that it was very beneficial. The other Commissioners  asked if he
  could share materials with them and he agreed.

DIRECTOR COMMENTS

  Mr. Scherer stated that there will be a need for an April Planning
  Commission  meeting.

ADJOURNMENT

  The meeting was adjourned at 6:59 p.m. The next regular meeting of the
  Planning Commission will be held April 1 0,2024 at 6:30 p.m. in the Council
  Chambers, 3660 " D" Street,,  cA 91750
